title: Manufacturing Processes — 12-Mark Preparation
note: Original ACADRIX practice questions based on the R-2025 Unit V syllabus. These are not claimed to be official university questions or PYQs.

questions.question: Explain the basic casting process from pattern preparation to solidification and removal of the casting. Discuss the major advantages, limitations and applications of casting.
solutionPlan: Explain pattern, mould and metal preparation.
Describe pouring, solidification and shakeout.
Discuss finishing and inspection.
State advantages, limitations and applications.

questions.question: Explain metal forming processes and classify the major bulk and sheet-forming operations. Discuss the basic principle, advantages and applications of representative forming processes.
solutionPlan: Define metal forming and plastic deformation.
Classify bulk and sheet processes.
Explain representative operations such as rolling, forging and sheet forming.
Discuss advantages and applications.

questions.question: Explain the fundamental principles of machining. Discuss the roles of cutting tool, workpiece, machine tool and cutting conditions, and explain common machining operations.
solutionPlan: Define machining and material removal.
Explain tool-work interaction and chip formation conceptually.
Identify machine tool and cutting parameters.
Describe representative turning, drilling, milling and related operations.

questions.question: Explain the need for joining processes in manufacturing. Classify major joining methods and compare representative welding, brazing, soldering and mechanical joining processes.
solutionPlan: Define joining and its manufacturing role.
Classify fusion, solid-state and mechanical joining concepts.
Explain representative processes.
Compare strength, temperature, permanence and applications.

questions.question: Explain the concept and working of Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machining. Discuss the main elements of a CNC system, its advantages and its applications in modern manufacturing.
solutionPlan: Define CNC and numerical control.
Explain controller, drive system, machine tool and feedback concept.
Describe the basic programmed machining workflow.
Discuss accuracy, repeatability, productivity and applications.

questions.question: Explain additive manufacturing and its basic layer-by-layer principle. Discuss the general workflow, advantages, limitations and mechanical-engineering applications of additive manufacturing.
solutionPlan: Define additive manufacturing.
Explain digital model, slicing, layer deposition and post-processing.
Discuss material and process considerations.
State advantages, limitations and applications.

questions.question: Explain the concept of smart manufacturing and discuss how digital technologies, automation, data and connected machines influence modern manufacturing systems.
solutionPlan: Define smart manufacturing.
Explain connected equipment, automation and data-driven decision making.
Discuss monitoring, flexibility and integration.
Relate the concept to modern manufacturing applications.

questions.question: Compare casting and metal forming processes with respect to manufacturing principle, material behaviour, product geometry, dimensional characteristics, defects and applications.
solutionPlan: Explain the basic principle of each process.
Compare liquid-metal solidification with plastic deformation.
Discuss geometry, quality and defect considerations.
Give suitable application examples.

questions.question: Compare conventional machining and additive manufacturing in terms of material usage, geometry capability, accuracy, surface finish, production volume and suitable applications.
solutionPlan: Define subtractive and additive approaches.
Compare material flow and waste generation.
Discuss geometry, accuracy and surface-finish considerations.
Relate process choice to production requirements.

questions.question: Develop a systematic procedure for selecting a suitable manufacturing process for a mechanical component. Discuss material, geometry, size, tolerance, surface finish, production quantity, cost and quality requirements.
solutionPlan: Define component requirements.
Identify material and geometry constraints.
Evaluate tolerance, surface finish and production quantity.
Compare candidate processes and estimate cost/quality implications.
Select and justify the process route.

questions.question: Explain how casting, forming, machining and joining can be combined into a complete manufacturing route for a mechanical component. Discuss the purpose of each stage and the importance of inspection.
solutionPlan: Start from raw material and component requirements.
Select primary shaping by casting or forming.
Use machining for required dimensions and finish.
Use joining where assembly requires it.
Include inspection and quality control throughout.

questions.question: Discuss the advantages and limitations of CNC machining compared with conventional machining. Explain applications where CNC provides significant benefits.
solutionPlan: Compare control methods and operator involvement.
Discuss accuracy, repeatability, productivity and flexibility.
Explain programming, setup and investment considerations.
Identify suitable production applications.

questions.question: Discuss the suitability of additive manufacturing for prototypes, complex components and low-volume production. Explain the technical and economic factors that influence process selection.
solutionPlan: Identify applications enabled by layer-wise manufacturing.
Discuss complex geometry and rapid design iteration.
Consider material, build time, accuracy, finish and post-processing.
Compare economic suitability with conventional processes.

questions.question: Explain how CNC, additive manufacturing, automation and data connectivity can be integrated into a smart manufacturing environment. Discuss the expected benefits and practical challenges.
solutionPlan: Define the smart manufacturing environment.
Explain roles of CNC, additive systems and automation.
Discuss data collection, connectivity and process monitoring.
Evaluate productivity, quality and flexibility benefits and implementation challenges.

questions.question: Give a comprehensive account of casting, forming, machining, joining, CNC, additive manufacturing and smart manufacturing. Explain how process selection evolves from conventional manufacturing to digitally integrated production.
solutionPlan: Classify the major manufacturing process families.
Explain the principle and application of each.
Compare conventional and computer-controlled processes.
Explain the role of additive and smart manufacturing.
Conclude with integrated process-selection considerations.
